breakdown.description: Saturation temperature is inconsistent with the stated condenser pressure (10 kPa does not correspond to 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats both the condenser pressure of 10 kPa and the saturation temperature of 100°C without correcting or flagging the inconsistency. The ground truth indicates that 10 kPa corresponds to ~45.8°C, not 100°C. The agent failed to resolve this physical inconsistency and simply reproduced the erroneous values from the incomplete prompt.
